Auditor
An auditor is a person or a firm appointed by a company to execute an audit.
To act as an auditor, a person should be certified by the regulatory authority of accounting and auditing or possess certain specified qualifications.
The internationally recognised standard setting body for the profession is the Institute of Internal Auditors - IIA.

Subrogation
Subrogation is the assumption by a third party (a subrogee, such as a second creditor or an insurance company) of another party (a subrogor)'s legal right to collect debts or damages.
A right of subrogation typically arises by operation of law, but can also arise by statute or by agreement.
